title: site-network-baseline
description: Sets a site's network baseline, or clears it with null. Confirmed with an authenticator code bound to this exact baseline. Nothing changes on a cabinet; the network diagnosis compares cabinets with it.

stepUpToken.description: Optional: a one-time step-up token bound to this exact action. These settings change no cabinet by themselves, so no code is required; a token, if sent, is consumed.
